districtPreview.title: District snapshot

HomePage.intro: A practical local data tool for comparing Döner prices by shop, district, and freshness. The public dataset is still empty until reviewed observations are added.

mapPreview.body: The map MVP is a later step. This first product surface prepares the data views before adding map tiles or browser-only map code.
mapPreview.title: Map preview

pricePreview.emptyBody: The app is ready for reviewed records, but no public current prices have been published yet.
pricePreview.title: Price preview

HomePage.title: Find and compare Döner prices in Berlin

empty.body: The production dataset is intentionally empty until reviewed shop observations are available.
empty.title: No current prices yet

PricesPage.intro: A server-rendered list of the latest non-outdated prices per shop and product type.
PricesPage.title: Current Döner prices

empty.body: Rankings need reviewed current standard Döner prices. Demo data will only be added later if it is clearly marked.
empty.title: No ranking data yet

RankingPage.intro: Cheapest, most expensive, recently updated, and best-confidence views use the latest non-outdated standard Döner prices.
RankingPage.title: Berlin price rankings

DistrictsPage.caveat: District statistics are descriptive only. Low sample counts are a caveat, not a definitive ranking.

empty.body: District rows will appear once reviewed current standard Döner prices are available.
empty.title: No district statistics yet

DistrictsPage.intro: Compare average, median, minimum, and maximum prices by district or neighborhood once reviewed data exists.
DistrictsPage.title: District price statistics

MethodologyPage.intro: How prices are collected, reviewed, ranked, and marked as stale.

districts.body: District statistics use latest non-outdated standard Döner prices and show average, median, minimum, maximum, sample count, and last update.
districts.title: District statistics

freshness.body: Prices older than 180 days are marked outdated and excluded from default rankings. Confidence is adjusted by data age.
freshness.title: Freshness and confidence

limitations.body: The dataset is currently empty. If generated demo records are added later, they must be visibly marked as unverified and kept distinguishable from verified observations.
limitations.title: Limitations

rankings.body: Default rankings use standard Döner only, select the latest price per shop, and exclude outdated observations.
rankings.title: Ranking rules

review.body: Submissions are manually reviewed before publication. The MVP does not publish real-time user submissions.
review.title: Manual review

sources.body: The app reads static CSV and JSON files at build or server-render time. Public data should contain only reviewed information safe to publish.
sources.title: Static sources

MethodologyPage.title: Methodology and data caveats

corrections.body: A public correction contact path will be configured later without exposing private submitter details.
corrections.title: Corrections

form.body: A public form can be connected later for non-technical contributors. No external form service is configured in this plan.
form.title: Public form

github.body: Technical contributors can suggest data corrections or schema improvements through GitHub.
github.title: GitHub issue

SubmitPage.intro: Contribution paths are intentionally simple and manually reviewed before publication.
SubmitPage.reviewNotice: Submitted prices should include a date, shop address, product type, and source context. Nothing becomes public without review.
SubmitPage.title: Submit a Döner price
